# Project Section

At the root level of a project file, you define overall project settings.  
The following properties are available:

- `"name"`: A string value representing the name of the report.
- `"auto-refresh"`: Whether the project reloads itself when its dataset files change. \
  The files are checked every 5 seconds, and the reload waits until a changed file is no longer being written to or locked by another process. \
  This only takes effect if every dataset is imported from a local or network file (not a URL). \
  The default is `false`.
- `"watermark"`: Defines a watermark to add to each page. \
  Available options:
  - `"label"`: The text to display across pages.
  - `"color"`: The watermark color (name or hex value).
- `"html-export"`: Defines the options used when exporting the project as an HTML dashboard. \
  Available options:
  - `"theme"`: The name of the dashboard theme.
  - `"logo"`: The path to an image shown at the left of the title bar.
  - `"view"`: How the pages are initially presented. \
    Available options:
    - `"gallery"` (default): Small page cards across the top, with the selected page shown below.
    - `"slides"`: All pages stacked in a scrolling slideshow.
  - `"color-mode"`: The initial light/dark mode. \
    Available options:
    - `"auto"` (default): Follows the browser's setting.
    - `"light"`
    - `"dark"`
  - `"color-mode-toggle"`: Whether to include the Auto/Light/Dark toggle. \
    The default is `true`.
  - `"count-up"`: Whether large numbers count up when a page is revealed. \
    The default is `true`.
  - `"page-width"`: The width (in DIPs) that each page is rendered at.
    The default is `1280`.
  - `"page-height"`: The height (in DIPs) that each page is rendered at.
    The default is `720`.
  - `"dual-orientations"`: Whether to also render each page with its width and height swapped. \
    The browser then shows whichever orientation best fits its window. \
    For example, with a page size of 1280 x 720, a portrait (720 x 1280) copy of each page is included. \
    If the width is less than the height, the swapped copy is the landscape one.
  - `"include-save"`: Whether to include the Save button, which saves the current page as an SVG or PNG file. \
    The default is `true`.
  - `"include-print"`: Whether to include the Print button, which prints the current page. \
    The default is `true`.
  - `"include-copy"`: Whether to include the Copy button, which copies the current page as an image or a link to it. \
    The default is `true`.
  - `"include-group-visibility-toggles"`: Whether the Filters menu includes checkboxes that hide or show a graph's groups (e.g., a pie slice or a line series). \
    A graph's `"filter"` choices are always included. \
    The default is `false`.
- `"export-excluded-pages"`: Defines the pages that are left out of each export format. \
  Each property is an array of page `"guid"` values (see [Pages](#page-properties)). \
  Pages that aren't listed are included, so pages added later are exported by default. \
  This is written when the project is saved after choosing pages in the export dialog.
  (It is also applied when exporting from the command line.) \
  Available options:
  - `"svg"`: The pages to leave out of SVG exports.
  - `"html"`: The pages to leave out of HTML dashboard exports.
  - `"pdf"`: The pages to leave out of PDF exports.
  - `"pptx"`: The pages to leave out of PowerPoint exports.
  - `"odp"`: The pages to leave out of OpenDocument presentation exports.

### Examples {-}

```json
{
  "name": "RETENTION"
}
```

Boilerplate project containing pages and rows of items:

```json
{
  "name": "RETENTION",
  "pages": [
    {
      "rows": [
        {
          "items": [
            {
            ...
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```
